_what_this_is: The RAW envelope of the drafting act that produced the demonstrating mapping proposal, committed so a reviewer has something checkable rather than the builder's say-so. Recorded verbatim; nothing here is reconstructed.
_honesty_note: This is a record of PRESENCE, not a cryptographic proof of ORIGIN. It shows a real model, a real prompt whose hash matches the committed file, and the response that prompt produced. It cannot prove to a third party that the response came from that model rather than from a person typing — closing that gap needs signed attestation from the provider, which does not exist today. The residual is stated in 05_analytics_methodologies/ingest_mapping_drafting_v1.md section 5 rather than papered over.
ran: operator-side, outside the deployed product; no API key exists in the deployed stack (OQ-ING-3=A)
inputs_seen: schema only — column names, inferred types, and shape-preserving obfuscated samples. Zero client holdings. The obfuscated sample table in prompt.md IS the entire data surface.
notes: DATE FORMAT IS AN ASSUMPTION, and it is the one worth challenging at ratification. The sample 99/99/9999 is ambiguous between day-first and month-first. I assumed DAY-FIRST because the file is GBP-denominated (a 'Book Cost (GBP)' column and a 'Ccy' column sampling as three letters), and UK custodian statements are day-first. If the supplier is North American this is wrong for the first twelve days of every month and silently right for the rest, which is the worst possible failure shape. A human should confirm it against one real row before ratifying.
'Nominal (000s)' is scaled by 1000 on the strength of the column NAME, not the sample. The sample 99.9 is consistent with either reading.
The sign is preserved: 'scale' multiplies, so a negative nominal stays negative and a short position lands short.

DELIBERATELY UNMAPPED: 'Security Description' (a label, not a canonical target), 'Asset Class' (a property of the security master, not of a holding), and 'Ccy' (a property of the instrument, not of the position row). Mapping any of them would put file-supplied text where reference data belongs.
I did not propose a 'constant' for any required target. Every one of the four is derivable from a real column, so a constant would have been a guess wearing a declaration's clothes.
